name: anim_trio_dragdown
subject: a heaving mass of pink paint goo with yellow marble streaks holding a small black witch cat, on a paint puddle
desc: The goo mass wraps around the cat and slowly drags it down, sinking back into the flat floor puddle; the cat is pulled under, its paws and hat disappearing last, thick sticky strands stretching down, until only a flat bubbling puddle remains. Slow, heavy, viscous.
